notes.title: CONTINUE BUG FIX
notes.content:
CONTINUE BUG FIX

Fixed a bug that caused the player to start at a boss when continuing instead of in the upgrade room on Page and Squire difficulties
Automatically fully power up player on death at final boss

notes.title: LOCALIZATION BUG FIX
notes.content:
LOCALIZATION BUG FIX

Some users see an error that no translations are available. Language fallback was reimplemented and assets recompiled to address this.

notes.title: Text Bug Fix
notes.content:
TEXT BUG FIX

A bug which prevented text from displaying properly for some players has been fixed

notes.title: Dire Vengeance Difficulties
notes.content:
Dire Vengeance Difficulties

2 additional difficulties have been added to the original gameplay difficulty

The 3 difficulty levels are:
Page (Easy)

 Pandora deals 50% more damage to enemies
 Pandora takes 50% less damage from enemies
 Pandora loses 1 upgrade each time she dies
 Pandora always respawns at the beginning of the level she died, even when continuing


Squire (Medium)

 Pandora deals standard damage to enemies
 Pandora receives standard damage from enemies
 Pandora loses 1 upgrade each time she dies
 Pandora always respawns at the beginning of the level she died, even when continuing


Knight (Hard)

 Pandora deals standard damage to enemies
 Pandora receives standard damage from enemies
 Pandora loses all upgrades each time she dies
 Pandora respawns to the last boss or mini-boss when continuing

notes.title: GAME TIMER, BUG AND BALANCE FIXES
notes.content:
Want to know how long it took you to beat Dire Vengeance? Now you can! A new game timer has been added. In order to use it, just start the game from Stage 1 and play through to the end. Your final time will be shown in the "Thank You" screen. How fast are you really?
